review_text: 5/5 for this newly discovered café. the iced spanish latte? ✅ was the food worth it? ✅ internet connection? ✅ cleanliness, especially the restroom? ✅ the background music? ghaddd, perfection! 💯 the staff? very warm and welcoming. it is not crowded either, which made the whole place feel even more relaxing. and as someone whose eyes are sensitive to bright lights, I really appreciated the dim lighting. 🫶🏻

I always enjoy their rice meals. Just the right amount of flavor and serving. Beverage selection is diverse, and can cater to different preferences—I particularly enjoy their coffee w/ liquor options. Their egg tarts is also good, makes a good pair with their tea selection. As for the place, it's perfect if you want to meet-up with some friends, do a bit of work, or maybe just a you-time. It is intimate and cozy.

Food and drinks were delicious. We tried their Katsu Alfredo and Brownie Basque Cheesecake. Hopefully we can try their other meals next time. The place has dim lighting perfect for dates or friendly chitchats.

It was a delight to spend a working day at this cafe. I was extremely satisfied with the food, the ambiance, and the service. What a lovely cafe, not at all crowded, a perfect place for people like me who stay away from busy establishments. Wifi was good and I was able to finish all my daily tasks. Toilet was nice and clean. Above all, coffee was great 🤍

Vanilla espresso was actually fairly good, not overly bitter nor sweet. Great drink to start the morning. Completely disappointed with the angus burger. Buns were cold and not toasted, patty was dry as a hockey puck and didnt taste like beef. Did not feel it was worth the 300+ price tag.

my fav coffee shop in davao. go here if you want some place to chill with decent coffee and food. i always go here to watch movies and work and its been a pleasant experience every time. food is pricey but you can stay as long as you want. their wifi lasts for 5 hours. CR is also good.
I wasn't impressed Espresso way too much liquid & much too hot. Venue is nice though

One of the better coffee shops in Davao. It's a great alternative to the chain coffee shops as it is just walking distance from SM Lanang. I ordered a Flat White, while my friends ordered a Latte. I would've wanted the Flat White to be a bit stronger. For a third wave coffee shop, the notes of the beans are not as pronounced as I hoped it would be. I also tried the cheesecake but it was a bit underwhelming for me. The vibe of the coffee shop is warm and dim, perfect for intimate get togethers. I also hope that the baristas would be a bit friendlier, they were a bit closed off and not as warm as the coffee shop intends to be. I hope they can improve on their coffee strength and customer service.

I really like the interior of the place. Although the lighting is dim, it adds to the personality of the cafe. It's a nice place to just chill and wait for time to pass by. Would not recommend reading a book here though just because of the lighting, but you could always sit by the window to get that natural lighting. As for the drinks, they offer a variety of choices which are not found in other cafés which was refreshing. I ordered their jeju matcha latte and it had this deep grassy taste which I liked, but it wasn't sweet so if you have a sweet tooth, you could probably ask for a packet of sugar to go with the latte. My boyfriend ordered their black vanilla which is basically just like a cold brew, but with vanilla flavoring. The vanilla was very rich combined with the cold brew which I enjoyed. Would definitely come back here.

First time at this cafe — one staff was busy mopping the floor but stopped and attended to me right away. The interior feel was an appropriate place to quietly work. The whitecap, chicken pop-chos, and tomato basil as suggested by the cashier tasted okay but I was expecting more….Had an issue at the parking lot upon leaving though, but surely interested to come back and try other interesting items on the menu.

We were just looking for a place to settle in since our friend is going to attend her class during one of our trips to Davao. We found this cute little cafe near SM Lanang, the place is very cozy, has a stable wifi and I love the atmosphere. I tried their Cafe Con Leche or Spanish Latte and I really love it. Plus the CR is so nice and clean 😍😍 I love this place. ,💕💕

clean, cozy & aesthetic place serving delicious drinks and baked goods :) would recommend their biscoff cheesecake! minus 1 star for their cr door. its a sliding wooden door and even if its closed, there is a space at the side where one can peak and can see the inside of the cr 🥲 i hope that gets taken care of
This place is a hidden gem. Good coffee that is reasonably priced. I got the dark mocha. Coffee, milk and coco powder. It was bitter but good. The inside is contemporary and clean.

My friend brought me to their most favorite coffee shop in J.P Laurel Ave! I'm really not a fond of coffee so they suggested to try with their premium coffee drink and I surprisingly liked it. 😊 The baristas were very hospitable and friendly to us. Also, they sell merchandise and have a bunch of cool stuff around. 👍🏻
Quiet cafe tucked in beside a hotel. Coffee here is really good as well as the chocolate chip cookie

A bit on the expensive side but their Flat White was really good! I also really vibe with their aesthetics! Went in on a rainy Sunday night but I think the place would look better during the day. Parking might be tough during peak hours though. Not sure if they accept cards or online payment.

They offer different kinds of specialty coffees and all of their coffees are really great! Specialty experience! If you’re a coffee enthusiast you should check this out! My personal fave is their osmanthus latte, the taste and aroma of osmanthus hits differently.

Excellent food, staff is so knowledgeable. I don't know much about coffee, but the staff knows there stuff so well and is able to make recommendation. I imagine if you are an avid coffee lover you will appreciate this place even more.

Located in a hotel building, this artisan cafe exudes artistic interior design. Located along the busy streets of JP Laurel, it is a must go-to place for coffee enthusiasts. There’s an inviting atmosphere to converse and not leave the place once inside. Overall, excellent experience. Highly recommended.
Ordered hazelnut iced latte with oatmilk. Very delicious and smooth espresso taste!!
Best place to relax ✨ The coffee, pastries and meals they serve is very delicious 🤤 Very perfect! Highly recommend ✅
It's very hard to find good coffee in the Philippines but this place is great. Nice smooth coffee with a bit of a nutty taste.
Great coffee and very comfortable ambiance.. I really like the chairs. Their staff is also very friendly.
Nice drinks, nice food, nice ambience, nice staff overall 9/10

There is this spot at the high table where you sit directly across their AC and the cold blowing on you is just unbearable that you'd have to transfer to another table or just leave by finishing your coffee in a hurry.

I really love the coffee! I also got to meet the SCA Certified owner and was happy with the hospitality she showed us. The pourover and latte we ordered was definitely good! It's one of the best specialty coffee in Davao for me.

coffee was good, really nice atmosphere for doing work/school-related tasks, the staff were very responsive and friendly, and lots of sockets (just ask for the round light-up thingy at the counter : ) ++ the cr was super clean
Ideal place to kill time, well air-conditioned and quiet. vast options for a specialty coffee lover,not to mention how cozy rest room 😉

We've ordered three times sa Grab and two of those orders have meals(Tocino meal and English breakfast meal) and it's always not good when I received it. The rice from the Tocino meal was burnt and the waffle from an English breakfast style meal were so hard I couldn't eat it(seem to be very old waffle na gi microwave) Their coffee were great and their desserts too but their meals are always disappointing...
perfect! will definitely go back here. Excellent taste of coffee and pastries
Great place to stay. Wifi and sockets. Spacious. Interesting coffee menu. Lots of food to choose from.

The place is great for study-outs, snacks-with-friends, and coffee dates. The ambience is chill and the crew are approachable. The light is a bit dark, one that you can expect given that the place being at a corner Overall, I highly recommend the Brekky!

spacious place for a good conversation. clean restroom. the best seller signature brew didnt strike as something memorable or special. the flavor that was suppose to be there didnt quite seem to stand out. do not expect anything much from the cakes. cheese cake and chocolate orange cake was a bit of a sad experience. if youre looking for a place to have a discussion with someone then maybe this can be a place to consider.
Hole in the wall type of cafe. Quiet and cozy. Good for working
Perfect place for work and relaxation. Great food and coffee.
a bit pricy but food was good but the coffee was better
A place fit for introverts with the best coffee.
Great coffee and fast wifi!
One of the few good cafes in Lanang, especially for those looking for a place to work or stay before heading to airport.
Chill place, tastes good. Perfect for chilling and studying. Not a coffee connoisseur, but other drinks taste great. Many choices for coffee and non coffee
Affogado was good. The ice cream was a small portion for a full shot of espresso. Ambience is laid back cool.
They offer specialty coffee,
I love how private this place is. The perfect ambiance to enjoy your peace and coffee.
Surprisingly good! Try the tea and coffee combination. I liked it.
Great cofee, very comfortable and quiet place.
love their mixes! the place is nice too
The place looks great and the sandwiches are delicious.
Awesome space for great coffee and food!
The only bad thing about this place is its parking area
Good place for some chit-chat
Great coffee & good food
Good staff
Perfect coffee brew.
We needed a GOOD coffee fix and found it buried in a small office complex. We didn’t take photos, but the coffee was excellent.

It's a bit difficult to spot this place from the street. It's tucked away in a corner of a building, and from the outside, it seems small. Parking is limited and cramped. Once you enter the front door, you'll notice the space is spacious. They have plenty of tables and chairs. The interior design is minimalist. There aren't any Instagram-worthy spots for group photos. The coffee menu is extensive, and they have their own signature coffee. There aren't many food options, just cakes. The staff were very friendly, answering questions and offering coffee recommendations. The coffee was delicious.
Beautiful lighting and great atmosphere
